newsitem.title: USA: Pearson to spin off Online Publishing unit.
newsitem.headline: Pearson to spin off Online Publishing unit.

text.p: Pearson Plc on Wednesday said it would spin off the Online Publishing division of Mindscape Inc to form a wholly owned business called Heartland Digital Media.

The new venture will focus on creating, publishing, and distributing digital programming, it said. It will capitalize on skills, technologies and products developed by the Online Publishing operation of Mindscape, a software company, during the last year.
Mark Nieker, formerly general manager and executive vice president of Mindscape Online, will serve as president of the new venture.
